condition: In R arrow, building an R object for a C++-defined extension type such as arrow.opaque (for example with as_data_type or arrow_table) segfaults, because ExtensionType__r6_class casts the type to RExtensionType without checking it is one.
workaround: Don't create the R type object: build tables with as_arrow_table() on a nanoarrow struct array, or read the data from Parquet.
